Ya like fishing? I could make more bait from leftovers. They loove munching on themselves!
D- do we want to fish more efficiently? I could make some more bait from fish..
So, what do you say?
Would that be.. useful?
Here you go, friend! Have fun fishing! Catch one bigger than my hat, will ya?
Here, I- I think this will do.. We hopefully get a return on this..
More food for us, right? Hah, all right then!
It’s okay. We might get hungrier later..  I- It’s better to save every bite we can for ourselves.
Cap’ Whiskers is just adorable. Watching the fish swim around the boat all day..
.. The cat tried to eat my hat..
Whiskers is really cute today.. He sat on my lap for hours, purring away..
Maybe I should teach him how to fish..
.. Again.
How.. peaceful...
Y’know.. I’m really bummed about the ship and the crew.. They were family to me, you get me?
There is no chance that the others have survived.
I-… I can’t see the others.. This is bad. Did they actually…? No, it can’t be..
I’m sure they would want us to keep going though, let’s not lose hope so quickly..!
… Let’s not be survivors for no reason. We have to keep going now.
.. T- the thought of only the two of us surviving.. Terrifying. But it’s a relief that w- we made it..
Darn! If I’d seen whatever hit our ship a lot earlier, we wouldn’t be stuck here now, would we?
Hmm... No icebergs in these waters. Whatever hit us wasn’t natural, that much’s clear.
What.. what even hit our ship? I- I didn’t see anything, it all happened so fast…
This old bucket’s indestructible though… You can bet on that!
.. Let’s just hope it doesn’t like small wooden boats.
But the sound… I -it's still making me uneasy. What made that sound..?
So many memories with Dorothy… And now it’s under the ocean..
.. I’m not sold on the idea that all this was a coincidence.
I- I miss my crew already.. And I really miss my plants. They were everything to me..
.. With all its shiny, metallic glory. It and the crew meant everything to me, buddy. Ya’ get me?
Stay cautious. They might still be onto us.
I- I’m sure this much salty water isn’t doing my small seedlings any good, oh dear...
We’ve got tons of stuff here, by the way! Great job getting it all on the boat, pal!
The boat is pretty well-packed. We can manage for a while with what we’ve got.
I- I’m glad we have all this stuff on the boat. I can see us going for days with it...
This boat looks pretty empty, bud. We should’ve brought more stuff with us, shouldn’t we?
Not many resources on the boat. We are in for some rough days ahead.
I’m worried about the lack of.. stuff.. on the boat. W- We’re going to have a tough time...
Say what ya’ will, but nothing beats the taste of sea air in the morning. Clears the mind..
We are far from shore. The silence is louder than a loaded gun. No one will hear us here, most likely.
At least t- the sea has a calming sound.. It clears my mind.. Makes it easier to sleep, too..
The sea’s probably just testing us. Or messing with us for fun. Let’s see who gets the last laugh!
If there is someone behind this with intent..
L-Lots of plants are actually pretty used to harsh environments…
Ha! Ha! Ha! …It’s me.
I will make sure this is the last ship they ever sink.
Well, let’s try to be like some really, really sturdy plants.. okay?
This place is way too quiet, y’know? My sailor’s gut’s telling me we’re drifting toward danger…
The ocean… Do not mistake calm for safety. That’s how people disappear.
I- I don’t like how empty the ocean is.. It feels wrong. Not even any plants, or just.. kelp.
Lau’ would’ve already started a small garden on this boat, haha!
Frederik was great at giving directions. He would have definitely sped up getting us home.
I miss Fred… H- he would have already started singing some dumb sailor’s song for us..
It’s pretty windy here.. I should’ve brought a spare jacket from.. his wardrobe. Hah!
I feel deep grief for Laurel. She didn’t deserve this. Neither of us did. But especially her..
I felt safer when.. He.. was there. H- he had a lot of weapons and tools, for any situation..
Hoping I made a good impression on my crew, what ya’ think?
I made a promise to protect them. I failed.
I hope that they didn’t think I.. or my hobbies were weird..
They’re probably laughing at us this moment, watching from the skies..
The least I can do now is not give up on them.
But I’m sure they’d be proud of us, right now.. We’re managing. We’re s- surviving..
Sorry if the smoke’s bothering you, pal. I need my pipe wherever I go.. Hope you get me!
.. I would rather perish by my own gun than by the sea. What about you..?
I- I brought some dried lavender in my bag... I- it helps when I feel anxious.
Ya’ think you could win an arm wrestle against me?
Are you easily startled?
Do.. do you have a favorite plant?
Gutsy! I see why you’re the one doing the fishing, haha!
Good. That means you are still paying attention.
T- That’s great! Mine are bay leaf trees. I used to collect a lot of bay leaves as a child…
You’re just being nice. I know I’m the strongest. And humble, of course.
Well then, gunshots at night won’t faze you if the sea forces me to act.
Oh.. Well, you remind me of sunflowers..
After all this, I think I’ll be getting a new tattoo. To remember that we made it.
Somebody must have seen us by now, stranded out here on this boat.
W- when we get home, I’m thinking about opening a flower shop..
We’ll get you one, too! What ya’ think?
Don’t you think?
Would you come to visit once?
Haha, that’s the spirit! I’m thinking about getting one that looks just like this ol’ rack we’re stranded on.
Right.. a few planes must have flown over and spotted us already…
T- Thanks.. I’d give you a discount on my poppies.
Come on! It’s gonna make a great story one day! Just let me know if you change your mind, ‘kay?
.. Let’s just hope you’re being overly pessimistic.
Are you… allergic? If so, I didn’t know, sorry…
Every time I light this pipe, I think of her…
This gun is not for threats, by the way.. It is for warnings.
I- I think the sea has moods. She was sad yesterday. I could feel it.
Tired as a barnacle, my friend..
My head feels heavy, I- I’m really tired..
I think I’ll just gaze at the clouds for the rest of the day, ‘kay?
S- Sorry, I won’t be much of a help today..
Buddy, I’ll be honest.. I don’t feel so well… I’m on the verge of throwing up, actually.
I- I don’t feel so well… I think I am getting seasick. But I’ll manage, don’t worry..
Don’t think I’m giving up that easy, though!
As long as only one of us feels sick, i- it’s fine. Right?
Eugh… My stomach hurts. Might have been too much seafood, yeah?
I think.. I feel dizzy and – my h- head hurts… Might be from too much sun exposure..
I can handle a lot.. except stale fish, I suppose.. You better double-check what you eat, ‘kay?
Anyway… At least you can handle it, as it seems.. One’s better than none. Right?
Morning! I had a weird dream last night.. There was a guy in a gondola, tryin’ to sell me stuff..
Once I had a nightmare… I was surrounded by sharks. But they had limbs. Human limbs.
I had the weirdest dream of my life.. W- we were surrounded by lily pads. Hundreds of them..
Mornin’! I had a weird dream last night.. more like a nightmare.. The sea was blood-red..
Once I had a nightmare… In it, I found the skeleton of my long-gone crewmate… in the sea.
I just had the strangest nightmare.. T- The moon had a face. And it wasn’t a h- happy one..
Mornin’! I had a weird dream last night.. a bunch of eyes, glowing in the sea, staring.. and then…
Once I had a nightmare.. The sea was watching me. With golden, glowing eyes.
I had the weirdest dream last night... L- lots of glowing eyes, just staring at me. And then… oh no..
It felt so real. Like it could’ve actually happened, and I’d believe it.
What’s with that look? Had a similar dream before?
.. But the dream felt.. real? Do you think it meant something?
.. Are you looking for this?
Don’t ask. Just take it.
That box.. Full of useless stuff. C- Could we make something out of it?
I mean, I’ll give it a shot. Let’s see.. hmm...
H- how surprising.. Junk could only be arranged into other junk. Oh well..
W- wow! I just made that, see? From scrap!
S- surprised myself, too. And I- I wasn’t even a girl scout, or.. anything like that.
No chest, just kelp and getting my clothes wet. It was fun though, you should try it sometime!
You know what, bud! Let’s try using that map of yours. Maybe we find something useful on it..
Hmm.. Let’s check that map real quick.
Oh, I know..! Let’s try using that map we have so we can find something that could help us..
Hand it over, will ya?
Hand it over for a bit.
C- could you lend it to me?
You’re the captain!
… OK.
Y- You seem sure about our whereabouts then.. right..?
Let me tell ya’, this map is really.. interesting. We should try finding one of the nearby islands!
.. If this has our current location, we should focus on finding one of the islands A.S.A.P… Kay’?
I- it’s not that likely we’re on this map, but if we are, then we should find some islands.. Right?
Looking at this, pal, we’re days away from reaching any land, so let’s make ourselves comfortable!
.. Unless someone finds us, we’re expected to be stuck here for a few days. Let’s focus.
It.. It looks like we’re way too far away from any shores.. We’re going to row for a few.. days.
Cool diving gear you got there, buddy! Can I give it a go? I could try finding something underwater!
Whatcha say?
Thanks, pal! Let me put this on, and off I go…!
Dang, you’re no fun, bud! Welp, we might need it later for a more important time though…
.. Look what I’ve got! It’s heavy, but might’ve been worth hauling up from the bottom!
..Nevertheless, I broke the gear. This sea’s no joke. I almost got hurt myself, too! Glad I didn’t.
Tell you what! Hand me some of that bait.. I’ll try fishing myself. We’ll eat for days, mark my words!
What do you say?
Ho-ho! Well then.. I wanna see you catching more fish than I could, buddy!
Whoops.. The greedy fishes just took our bait… At least they are not hungry anymore, yeah?
Look at that, buddy! That is my catch. Pretty neat, isn’t it?
Looks like some of our stuff is broken... I- I think I can help fix it!
Should I give this one a try?
Oh... s- so you're saying it's beyond repair… right?
All that exhausting work.. and I still couldn’t fix it. I’m sorry…
Yes! I did it.. Here you go, it’s usable now!
Hey, I think I see something down there.. just beside us in the water!
Oh.. I see something.. In the-.. the water! I could pull it up with a fishnet..
Quick, hand me the fishnet!
Could you lend me one, please?
...Huh? Ah, never mind, I lost sight of it.. Well then…
… Hmm. Now that you mention it, m- maybe it was just some big rocks. Oh well…
Wait- ..huff… this thing’s heavy… Look at this chest! What could it be hiding?
… Ugh, s- so heavy… but look! It’s a chest! What’s inside?
Well, one thing’s for sure it snapped the fishnet, so it better be worth it!
Oh no.. I broke the net.. Sorry.. I just hope whatever is in this chest makes up for it.
Aha! Look what the tide just carried in! I had just long enough arms to grab it..
This thing just got washed up by the waves..

Here, have it!
You can have it.
See?
Hmm..? What’s that behind your ear?
Interesting..
Oh.. I- I found something in the water just now..
Just kiddin’.. Look what I found in the water, though!

Here, take a look! C- can we use this?
Sorry bud! I actually fell asleep…

But I’m sure you could defend yourself, couldn’t you?
I hope nothing bad happened.. Did it?
Y’know what? I feel helpful today! I can guard you tonight so you have a restful night’s sleep.
Nights getting rough? I can help you get through the next one.
I-.. Overslept. So I’ll think I can stay up this night and guard, while you rest..
Guess what! Night guard duty’s back on the menu. Say the word if ya want a problem-free night!

I overslept again… Do you need rest tomorrow night? I can stay up if you want.
What do you say?
What do you say?
What do you say?
Super! You can rest assured to have the best sleep of your life, buddy!

Okay then! Don’t break our habits, right?
.. Confident.
Hah, t- that’s fine, too! If you insist.
Well, friend, the most interesting thing about last night was you talking in your sleep…
… You look like someone who had a nightmare.
Huh, last night, I swear I heard s- something..
But hey, nobody got hurt, so I did my duty. Another win for me, yeah?!
Anyway, you are unharmed. No need to thank me.
But nothing really happened, so there’s that.. Glad y- you could catch up on sleep!

See? And I- it didn’t even hurt, right?

Well, here goes nothin’..
I hope it finds someone.. Then returns it, of course. It’s my cigar box.
I could try fishing, but I have my methods, so to say..
Can I?
That’ll do. Hope nothing was alerted in the deep from that.
Okay then. You do you.
Next time we get stranded, I’m bringin’ a deck of cards.. And a looooot of beer.
If I am ever not on this boat when you wake up… assume the worst.
D- Don’t worry, I’m not seasick. I’m just… emotionally wavy today.
With Dorothy sunk, we need a new name for this dinghy we’re on…
Sitting and staring out on this boat is rather boring for you too, I assume…

But if you start singing a sea shanty, I will personally abandon ship.
… W- why are you looking at me like that?

.. We should compete to see which one of us is more resilient.
I think.. I see something green growing between the planks.. t- this can only mean one thing…
… Jeff says hi.
Let’s say… whoever can keep their right leg in the salty ocean the longest. How does that sound?
I can have my own small personal garden here..!

Heads up. We have already survived {X} nights.. We may not need many more to do so.

T- this deck’s getting more and more uncomfortable to sleep on by the day…
If only we had fire to cook it with… without burning the planks, obviously..
Makes my gun more likely to jam.
I might have to take something from the junk box to cushion my head tonight…

W- why did the company insist we have weapons on board? Were those... n– necessary?
They had to know the risks, right?
Still not sure if that was a compliment or a warning.
What were they expecting..?
Funny how a company this famous hasn’t even tried to find us yet…
Do you think the company left us here on purpose?
W- why aren’t they looking for us? Did the company just.. abandon us?
Ya’ think this is why they told us the job had to stay between us and the company?
The company told me things they said were just for me to know…
They didn’t tell me anything… Were they trying to protect me?
Now I feel stupid for not telling a single soul.. My momma would already be out here swimming for us!
Why be so damn secretive?
.. Like they knew this could happen? D- did they think I’d freak out if I knew?
I wanna see the face of the guy who got us into this mess…
They told me ‘The Contractor’ would always be watching us..
And we never even knew who our contractor was.. They kept him a secret.
The only thing we know about him is that he calls himself ‘The Contractor’.. What a weird guy..
Was that supposed to be a joke? Or are they actually watching us suffer right now?
I- I mean all we know is he literally calls himself ‘The Contractor’..
They said the Contractor considered this his most important job to offer… and we messed it up..
The Contractor’s probably not gonna be happy we failed the job…
The company.. They made the Contractor seem… d- desperate..
Ugh… This Contractor guy’s probably a rich, heartless jerk who treats people like us as tools..
Huh… ‘Contractor.’ What a heartless skunk.
I- if the Contractor had a heart, he’d be looking for us… right?
Y’know, these waters… they’re telling me this wasn’t any ordinary transport mission..
Maybe it is better for both of us if they never see us again.
W- What if... we can still finish the job? What if we never needed the ship in the first place?
You're a quiet one, huh...
That’s the look of someone carrying secrets.
Your f- face... it tells me you know more than I do.
Hey, if you know something I should, don't keep it to yourself, alrighty?
And if I am right, maybe it’s time you ask yourself if they’re worth keeping.
Please- if you think you’ve got answers to any of this, don’t hold back.
Days.. weeks… I smell like aged tuna that’s been thrown up.. twice.
… You smell awful.
It’s not exactly comfy wearing the same clothes this long...
Just how much longer do we have to keep fightin’, bud?
Don’t stress it.. We’ve been stranded out here a long time.
I just-..  I just wanna live long enough to take a well-earned, relaxing shower..
I swear, my hair’s getting grayer by the day… Hey, what’s that look?
In this tiny boat.. Even my peg leg is starting to ache.
If I were a plant…
Ya’ think I’m bald? Under this hat is the most magnificent hair you’ve ever seen!
You know about phantom pain, don’t you? When something’s gone, but it still hurts like it’s there…
I’d be a dry, tired, tattered little shrub, barely hanging on..
If either of us makes it out alive… we should get a new ship- one named after those we lost.. ‘kay?
When I die, I want my ashes mixed with gunpowder… then fired into the sky.
Well.. if I don’t make it.. c- could you take care of my plants for me, please?
I..  I thought I heard voices. But there’s only fish… Can fish talk here? Did you hear them too?
Hold yourself together. We cannot give up now.
I think… I- I’m having a reverse mirage.. I’m starting to see land in the ocean..
I’d imagine this is worse than when you sued the company for your botched surgery.. yeah?
Still chasing that dream of yours, by the way? You know... that one.
M- my brother warned me not to take this job. Thought he was being overprotective... Oh well.
I wish I had more lives… y’know? Just one might be enough to get us outta here, huh?
Hmm.. ‘The Heart of the Sea’…
When I was a kid, my friends used to whisper rumors about the sea…
I’ve only heard the old tales, though… A friend of mine swore it was possible..
Endless possibilities, or so they say.
One of them mentioned s- something called ‘The Heart of the Sea’, I think..
With something called ‘The Heart of the Sea’. No idea what that means, but it sure sounds mysterious!
Personally? I don’t believe a word of it.
T- They said it could save you from certain death.. I don’t buy it.. but I’d still like to have one.
Oh, you’re up! You won’t believe what happened!
Oh, good morning.
Oh, you’re awake… s-something weird happened this morning.
This morning, just after I woke up, a seagull flew by and snatched my pipe!
Don’t mind the holes.
A seagull flew by with a flower in its beak.. then dropped it right into our boat.
What kind of bird wants to smoke, huh?
I was practicing.
S- So naturally, I scraped up whatever dirt I could find and planted it. Look at her.. happy as can be.
I have nothing to say today, buddy. What’s up?
… Nothing to say today.
Well... I- I don’t have anything to say today…
Nothing to talk about today except the weather… It’s a nice one we’re having today, aye?
… I’m out of words today, I guess.
I miss my plants… That’s all. Sorry, I don’t have anything to say today…
Hmm… My beard looks nice today. That’s all I can say.
… Sorry, I’m busy thinking to myself today.
… I- I don’t feel like chatting today… Sorry…
I swear last night I heard singing… It was spooky, but also calming. A voice singing my own name…
I heard a voice last night. Sounded like a woman in the distance. But I saw no one.
Last night, I- I heard a voice.. similar to mine. It was.. singing?
Anyway, most likely a dream.. Albeit a wild one, hah!!
Also, it was singing. Singing your name.
Maybe I was already half asleep, imagining things.. R- right?
Last night was pretty foggy, right? I swear I could make out figures from the fog.
Last night had more fog than usual… and that fog…
I-I could not see a thing last night, It was way too foggy..
Just kidding.. I’m only trying to spook you. For the laughs! Or am I..?
It felt alive.
And it didn’t help that it was moving in all.. weird kinds of ways. L- like, it had a mind of its own..
Did you see that last night? It was like.. a great tentacle.. thing, in the distance! A big ol’ squid?
Did you ever hear the tales about the gods beneath the sea?
Weird.. t- the boat was rumbling in an odd way last night..
I’d love reeling it in, you get me? Of course, it likely would not fit on this tiny boat of ours… hah!
Living deep where no human ever sails. I don’t see anyone around… do you?
L- Like something was sliding across the bottom..
Do you wanna know what I find really odd, bud?
.. On some nights, fish that show up get pretty… large.
W- Why do the larger fish only come up at night?
The fish I see at night… they’re way bigger than usual.. We should try fishing at night once!
Yesterday, I saw one swim by that was about your size.
… How big are the biggest..?
Hey! Did you hear that last night? Was it a blue whale? A shark?
.. Last night did not feel quiet.
D- did you hear that.. last night? What was that noise? Oh my..
Buddy! You look hurt. Did you have a fight with a shark last night? Seriously, try to be safer tonight!
.. Where did you get those scars?
A- are you okay? You look really hurt.. Please, be more careful!  J- just hang in there, okay?
It was a rough last night, for sure.. Thought I wasn’t seasick, but that.. was something else, yeah?
.. My jacket got all wet.
M- my clothes got soggy and I was freezing last night.. I hope the weather gets better..
Did you find something interesting last night, buddy? Tell me about it!
.. Hmm. Somebody had an unusual night.
Y- you look like you found something interesting last night.. What was it?

.. Thanks for waking up last night.

We’re arriving at some dangerous waters here, aren’t we, buddy?
Looks like we are getting somewhere. Be careful, now.
T- the sea seems.. More dangerous than before.. right?
Heyho! Looks like tons of fishies are here today! We should try catching some!
Lots of fish today. Let’s catch some.
I- it looks like there are a lot of fish today... We should try to catch some.
Darn! M’shoes got all soggy!
.. The end of my peg is all soaked through.
M- my shoes are filled with water.. So uncomfortable, ugh..
That’s a cute bird over there! Do you already have a name for it, bud?
Seagulls.. So annoying.
